pad.title: Education should end with a job, not a certificate.
pad.body: Legacy Educa bridges the gap between learning and professional practice. Every program is built backward from real job requirements — the skills taught are the skills demanded by the companies hiring inside the CodeLoop Ecosystem and beyond.

steps.title: Enroll
steps.description: Apply for your chosen program with a short profile. We review fit and learning readiness — not credentials — and respond within five business days.

steps.title: Learn
steps.description: Follow a structured curriculum with live sessions, async materials, and weekly check-ins. Cohort size is capped at 20 so every student gets real attention.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Complete hands-on projects at each module stage. Your mentor reviews your work and gives direct, actionable feedback — not automated grading.

steps.title: Certify
steps.description: Upon completion, receive a Legacy Educa certification that documents your specific skills, projects, and mentor endorsements — not just a completion badge.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.description: Your profile is actively shared with hiring partners inside the CodeLoop Ecosystem. Most graduates receive their first relevant introduction within 30 days of certification.
